modern: About death: whether it is a scattering, or a breaking up into atoms, or annihilation, it is either extinction or change.
original: About death: whether it is a dispersion, or a resolution into atoms, or annihilation, it is either extinction or change.

explained.summary: On death: whether it means being scattered, broken into atoms, or simply ceasing to exist, it is either an ending or a change. Marcus doesn’t claim to know which. His point is that neither possibility is something to dread.
